WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_spend AS (
    -- Sum all recorded payments for an order before counting orders.
    SELECT p.order_id,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.payment_value) = COUNT(*)
                THEN SUM(p.payment_value) END AS spend
    FROM order_payments AS p
    JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON d.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT d.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase_timestamp,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           -- Keep every delivered order; spend is unknown if any order lacks payment data.
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.spend) = COUNT(*)
                THEN ROUND(SUM(p.spend), 2) END AS total_spend
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
),
customer_rfm AS (
    -- Recency is elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered-order purchase
    -- to the latest delivered-order purchase in the full dataset.
    SELECT *,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(latest_purchase_timestamp) OVER ())
               - JULIANDAY(latest_purchase_timestamp) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
percentiles AS (
    -- Rank best to worst. CUME_DIST keeps equal values in the same percentile band.
    SELECT *,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS r_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (
               PARTITION BY total_spend IS NULL ORDER BY total_spend DESC
           ) AS m_pct
    FROM customer_rfm
),
scores AS (
    -- Scores 1–5 use the 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80% cumulative percentile cutoffs.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           1 + (r_pct > 0.2) + (r_pct > 0.4) + (r_pct > 0.6) + (r_pct > 0.8) AS r,
           1 + (f_pct > 0.2) + (f_pct > 0.4) + (f_pct > 0.6) + (f_pct > 0.8)
             + CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
                   1 + (m_pct > 0.2) + (m_pct > 0.4) + (m_pct > 0.6) + (m_pct > 0.8)
               END AS fm
    FROM percentiles
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND fm BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND fm BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND fm BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND fm BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND fm BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND fm BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND fm BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND fm BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND fm BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND fm BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND fm BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND fm BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
               ELSE 'Unclassified (missing spend)'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       rfm_segment,
       ROUND(total_spend / order_count, 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
       -- Compare segments by pooled spend / pooled orders, not by averaging customer ratios.
       ROUND(SUM(total_spend) OVER segment / SUM(order_count) OVER segment, 2)
           AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
FROM segmented
WINDOW segment AS (PARTITION BY rfm_segment)
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment, customer_unique_id;

WITH payments_by_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
    AVG(p.order_payment) AS average_payment_per_order,
    MAX(1.0, (
        JULIANDAY(MAX(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)))
        - JULIANDAY(MIN(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)))
    ) / 7.0) AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payments_by_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC, c.customer_unique_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id
     AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id
     AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
), qualifying_striker_totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM striker_match_runs
    GROUP BY striker
    HAVING MAX(match_runs) > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS average_total_runs
FROM qualifying_striker_totals;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id
    FROM player_match
), runs_by_player_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id, b.match_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id
     AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id
     AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
), player_averages AS (
    SELECT a.player_id, AVG(COALESCE(r.match_runs, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM appearances AS a
    LEFT JOIN runs_by_player_match AS r
      ON r.player_id = a.player_id AND r.match_id = a.match_id
    GROUP BY a.player_id
)
SELECT p.country_name, AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average
FROM player_averages AS pa
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC, p.country_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH top_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM olist_customers AS c
    JOIN olist_orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id
    LIMIT 3
), ranked_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state, o.order_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id
               ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp DESC, o.order_id DESC
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM olist_customers AS c
    JOIN olist_orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
), relevant_payments AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT order_id, payment_value
    FROM olist_order_payments
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM ranked_orders)
)
SELECT t.customer_unique_id,
       AVG(p.payment_value) AS average_payment_value,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.location_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_city END) AS customer_city,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.location_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_state END) AS customer_state
FROM top_customers AS t
JOIN ranked_orders AS r ON r.customer_unique_id = t.customer_unique_id
LEFT JOIN relevant_payments AS p ON p.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY t.customer_unique_id, t.delivered_order_count
ORDER BY t.delivered_order_count DESC, t.customer_unique_id;

WITH RECURSIVE
italian_customers AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
december_profit AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id,
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM profits AS p
    JOIN italian_customers AS c ON c.cust_id = p.cust_id
    WHERE p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
customer_profit AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, COALESCE(p.total_profit, 0.0) AS total_profit
    FROM italian_customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN december_profit AS p ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
),
profit_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit, MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM customer_profit
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT cp.total_profit,
           CASE
               WHEN r.min_profit = r.max_profit THEN 1
               ELSE MIN(10, 1 + CAST(10.0 * (cp.total_profit - r.min_profit)
                                    / (r.max_profit - r.min_profit) AS INTEGER))
           END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profit AS cp
    CROSS JOIN profit_range AS r
),
buckets(bucket) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket + 1 FROM buckets WHERE bucket < 10
)
SELECT b.bucket,
       COUNT(a.bucket) AS customer_count,
       MIN(a.total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
       MAX(a.total_profit) AS max_total_profit
FROM buckets AS b
LEFT JOIN assigned AS a ON a.bucket = b.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket
ORDER BY b.bucket;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
), customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_nodes
), monthly_transactions AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           SUM(CASE txn_type
                   WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                   WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
               END) AS balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01'
      AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
      AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date, 'start of month')
), customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT m.month_start,
           COALESCE(t.balance, 0) AS balance
    FROM months AS m
    CROSS JOIN customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_transactions AS t
      ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND t.month_start = m.month_start
), monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_customer_count,
           AVG(balance) AS average_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month_start
), extremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(positive_customer_count) AS highest_count,
           MIN(positive_customer_count) AS lowest_count
    FROM monthly_summary
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', h.month_start) AS highest_count_month,
       strftime('%Y-%m', l.month_start) AS lowest_count_month,
       h.average_balance AS highest_count_month_average_balance,
       l.average_balance AS lowest_count_month_average_balance,
       h.average_balance - l.average_balance AS average_balance_difference
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN monthly_summary AS h ON h.positive_customer_count = e.highest_count
JOIN monthly_summary AS l ON l.positive_customer_count = e.lowest_count
ORDER BY h.month_start, l.month_start;

WITH january_entries AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, DATE(insert_date) AS insertion_day, capital
    FROM cities
    WHERE DATE(insert_date) >= '2022-01-01'
      AND DATE(insert_date) < '2022-02-01'
), insertion_days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insertion_day
    FROM january_entries
), matching_countries AS (
    SELECT country_code_2
    FROM insertion_days
    GROUP BY country_code_2
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 9
), numbered_days AS (
    SELECT d.country_code_2, d.insertion_day,
           JULIANDAY(d.insertion_day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.country_code_2 ORDER BY d.insertion_day
           ) AS streak_key
    FROM insertion_days AS d
    JOIN matching_countries AS m ON m.country_code_2 = d.country_code_2
), streaks AS (

WITH customer_spending AS (

           COALESCE(SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_details AS od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01'

    GROUP BY o.customerid
)

       COUNT(s.customerid) AS customer_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(s.customerid) /
           NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_spending), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM customergroupthreshold AS t
LEFT JOIN customer_spending AS s
    ON s.total_spent BETWEEN t.rangebottom AND t.rangetop
GROUP BY t.groupname, t.rangebottom
ORDER BY t.rangebottom;

WITH cast_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT film_id, actor_id
    FROM film_actor
), cast_sizes AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM cast_members
    GROUP BY film_id
), film_revenues AS (
    SELECT f.film_id, f.title,
           ROUND(TOTAL(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM film AS f
    LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
), ranked_films AS (
    SELECT cm.actor_id, fr.title,
           fr.total_revenue / cs.actor_count AS average_revenue_per_actor,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY cm.actor_id
               ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, fr.film_id
           ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM cast_members AS cm
    JOIN cast_sizes AS cs ON cs.film_id = cm.film_id
    JOIN film_revenues AS fr ON fr.film_id = cm.film_id
)
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name,
       rf.title AS film_title,
       rf.average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films AS rf
JOIN actor AS a ON a.actor_id = rf.actor_id
WHERE rf.revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, a.actor_id, rf.revenue_rank;

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model(product_id, mth, ending_inventory, qty_minimum, qty_purchase) AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, '2018-12-01', i.qty, p.qty_minimum, p.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_totals AS i
    JOIN product_minimums AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT i.product_id,
           DATE(i.mth, '+1 month'),
           i.ending_inventory - COALESCE(o.qty, 0)
               + CASE
                     WHEN i.ending_inventory - COALESCE(o.qty, 0) < i.qty_minimum
                     THEN i.qty_purchase
                     ELSE 0
                 END,
           i.qty_minimum,
           i.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_model AS i
    LEFT JOIN monthly_orders AS o
        ON o.product_id = i.product_id AND o.mth = DATE(i.mth, '+1 month')
    WHERE i.mth < '2019-12-01'
), ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth,
           ABS(ending_inventory - qty_minimum) AS absolute_difference,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id
               ORDER BY ABS(ending_inventory - qty_minimum), mth
           ) AS rn
    FROM inventory_model
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth < '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT product_id, mth, absolute_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH season_finales AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS final_round
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2001
    GROUP BY year
), ranked_scorers AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points) AS points_rank
    FROM season_finales AS sf
    JOIN races AS r ON r.year = sf.year AND r.round = sf.final_round
    JOIN driver_standings AS ds ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE ds.points > 0
), scoring_entries AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id FROM results WHERE points > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id FROM sprint_results WHERE points > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor
FROM ranked_scorers AS rs
JOIN races AS r ON r.year = rs.year
JOIN scoring_entries AS se ON se.race_id = r.race_id AND se.driver_id = rs.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = se.constructor_id
WHERE rs.points_rank = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT rs.year) DESC, c.name ASC, c.constructor_id ASC
LIMIT 5;
